routes.name: Egypt e-Visa (tourism)
routes.summary: Apply online for a tourist e-Visa if your country is on the eligible list. Apply at least 7 days before you travel.

other: Passport valid at least 6 months from arrival.
Bring a printout of the e-Visa, an itinerary, and hotel bookings or places you plan to visit.
Port authorities can still refuse entry.
Stay length is not stated on the pages we could read.

steps: Sign up on the official portal.
Fill in the application and pay by card.
Print the e-Visa and carry it.

routes.name: Visa on arrival and visa-free entry
routes.summary: Egypt has visa on arrival and visa-free rules for some passports. We could not open an official page with the list or fees, so check the portal before you go.

other: Official list not reachable by our tools. Confirm on visa2egypt.gov.eg or with an Egyptian embassy.
Transit visa rules also not confirmed.

routes.name: One-year temporary residence permit (non-tourism)
routes.summary: The Passports Administration issues one-year residence permits for employees, students, volunteers and family members. Work-based permits need a Ministry of Labor work permit.

other: Employees of government, public or business sector, and their spouses and children.
Private or investment sector employees need a Ministry of Labor work permit.
Students enrolled in a school, and parents of children studying in Egypt.
Foreigners volunteering at their own expense.
Foreign spouses of Egyptian women, wives and widows of Egyptian nationals, second-degree relatives of Egyptians (renewable).
Parents of investors get five years with an Investment Authority recommendation.

documents: Ministry of Labor work permit (private sector)

routes.name: Residence for real estate owners
routes.summary: Foreigners who own registered property in Egypt, plus spouse and children, can get residence. The value must have been transferred through an Egyptian bank.

investment.note: For ownership registered after 11/5/2017, transferred through an Egyptian bank. Before that date the minimum was 50,000 USD.

other: Ownership contract registered with an Egyptian notary public.
Permit duration not stated on the page.

routes.name: Five-year renewable residence permit
routes.summary: A five-year renewable permit for investors, older residents, property owners and some family members. It is the closest thing Egypt has to long-term residence.

other: Foreign investors, and their wives and children.
Former Egyptians who lost nationality after taking another, and their minor children.
Children of an Egyptian mother.
People over 60 who have lived in Egypt 10 years and have a means of support.
Wives and widows of Egyptian nationals.
Foreigners authorized under international agreements.
Owners of property worth USD 400,000.

routes.name: Residence for people over 50
routes.summary: People over 50 who have lived in Egypt 5 years in a row and have a means of living can get a residence permit. Or they can be under the custody of a relative up to the fourth degree.

other: 5 consecutive years living in Egypt and a means of living.
Duration not stated on the page.

routes.name: Citizenship by marriage (foreign wife of an Egyptian man)
routes.summary: A foreign wife of an Egyptian husband can apply through the consulate. The process takes about two years with check-ins every six months, then the Ministry of Interior decides.

other: Registered Egyptian marriage contract.
Couple appears at the consular section every six months for two years.
Ministry of Interior makes the final decision.
Fee and steps shown are from the US embassy page, other embassies may differ.

citizenship.note: The embassy page says Egyptian law allows dual nationality.

sources.label: Egyptian Embassy in the US, acquiring citizenship

routes.name: Citizenship by descent (Egyptian mother)
routes.summary: Children born to an Egyptian mother after 15 July 2004 are Egyptian automatically. Older children can apply and are granted citizenship one year after filing unless the Interior Minister rejects with reasons.

other: Applies to children of an Egyptian mother and a foreign father.
Adults 21 and over apply in person to the Passports, Immigration and Nationality Administration, not at the embassy.
Criminal record certificate required for the applicant.

citizenship.note: Dual nationality for these children is not stated on the page.

sources.label: Egyptian Embassy in the US, acquiring citizenship
